about.text: I am passionate about software development because it enables me to combine technology, logic, and creativity to solve real-world problems. I am eager to learn new technologies and enjoy challenging myself through projects that expand my technical knowledge.
about.text2: My problem-solving approach is analytical and solution-oriented. I identify the cause of a problem, explore different possibilities, and test solutions systematically. Creativity helps me think beyond the obvious, persistence keeps me moving forward, and collaboration helps me benefit from the experience and perspectives of others.

references.intro: I thrive both independently and as part of a team. Here’s what my colleagues have to say about working with me.

references.ref3: It was a great pleasure to work with Daniel. He knows how to encourage team members to present their best work, always adding something to brainstorm. He was always present and available to listen and help others.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: Protecting your personal data is important to me. This Privacy Policy explains, in accordance with Articles 12, 13, and 14 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), which personal data is processed when you visit this website or contact me.

hosting.title: 2. Hosting and server log data
hosting.text1: When you access this website, the hosting provider processes technically necessary connection data. This may include your IP address, the date and time of access, the requested file or page, the amount of data transferred, the referrer URL, browser type and version, operating system, and access status. This processing is necessary to provide the website securely and reliably and to detect and prevent attacks.
hosting.provider: Hosting provider: [Name, address, and link to the hosting provider’s privacy policy]
hosting.text2: Where the hosting provider processes data on my behalf, this is governed by a data processing agreement in accordance with Article 28 GDPR.
hosting.legalBasis: The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. My legitimate interest lies in providing a secure, functional, and economical website.
hosting.retention: Server log data is stored for [the hosting provider’s specific retention period] and subsequently deleted unless continued storage is necessary to investigate a security incident.

contactForm.title: 3. Contact requests and contact form
contactForm.text1: If you contact me by email or through the contact form, I process the information you provide to handle your request and answer any follow-up questions.
contactForm.data: The data processed may include your name, email address, message content, time of submission, and technically necessary metadata.
contactForm.legalBasis: If your request concerns a contract or pre-contractual steps, the legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Other requests are processed under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The legitimate interest is the appropriate handling and response to your request.
contactForm.requiredFields: The information marked as mandatory is required to process and respond to your request. Without this information, your request cannot be submitted through the form.
contactForm.recipients: Recipients may include the hosting provider, the form service, and the email provider. Add every service actually used here: [Provider and privacy information].
contactForm.retention: Your request will be deleted once it has been fully processed and no statutory retention obligations or legitimate reasons require continued storage. Intended standard period: [specific deletion period, for example six months after the request has been completed].

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and local storage
cookies.text1: This website currently uses no cookies requiring consent and no analytics, marketing, or tracking technologies. If this changes, this Privacy Policy will be updated and, where required, consent will be obtained before storing or accessing information in accordance with Section 25(1) TDDDG and Article 6(1)(a) GDPR.
cookies.language: Information may be stored locally in your browser to remember your selected language. This storage is necessary to provide the language setting you expressly requested. The legal bases are Section 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG and Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The setting remains stored until you delete your browser data or select a different language.

externalLinks.title: 5. External links
externalLinks.text: This website contains links to external services such as GitHub, LinkedIn, or Developer Akademie. Data is transferred to the relevant provider only after you open such a link. The operator of the external website is responsible for processing data there. Please refer to the respective provider’s privacy information.

security.title: 6. Encryption and data security
security.text: This website uses TLS encryption to protect transmitted data against unauthorized access by third parties. An encrypted connection can generally be identified by “https://” in your browser’s address bar. Despite appropriate technical and organizational measures, completely risk-free data transmission over the internet cannot be guaranteed.

recipients.title: 7. Recipients of personal data
recipients.text: Personal data is disclosed only where necessary to provide the website, handle your request, comply with a legal obligation, or on another lawful basis. Processors are contractually bound in accordance with Article 28 GDPR.

thirdCountries.title: 8. Transfers to third countries
thirdCountries.text: Personal data is transferred to countries outside the European Union or European Economic Area only where this is actually required for a service and permitted under Articles 44 et seq. GDPR. Where applicable, add the service, recipient country, and transfer mechanism here: [Details of the third-country transfer or “No transfer to a third country takes place.”].

retention.title: 9. Retention periods
retention.text: Personal data is stored only for as long as necessary for the relevant purpose. It is subsequently deleted unless statutory retention requirements, the establishment, exercise, or defence of legal claims, or another lawful reason requires continued storage.

rights.title: 10. Your rights
rights.intro: Subject to the applicable legal requirements, you have the following rights in particular:
rights.access: Access to your processed personal data under Article 15 GDPR
rights.rectification: Rectification of inaccurate data or completion of incomplete data under Article 16 GDPR
rights.erasure: Erasure of your personal data under Article 17 GDPR
rights.restriction: Restriction of processing under Article 18 GDPR
rights.portability: Data portability under Article 20 GDPR, where the statutory requirements are met
rights.objection: Objection to processing based on Article 6(1)(e) or (f) GDPR under Article 21 GDPR
rights.withdrawal: You may withdraw consent at any time with future effect under Article 7(3) GDPR. The lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal remains unaffected. To exercise your rights, you may contact the email address stated above.

complaint.title: 11. Right to lodge a complaint
complaint.text: Under Article 77 GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. In particular, you may contact the authority responsible for your habitual residence, your place of work, the place of the alleged infringement, or the competent state authority for the controller.

automatedDecisions.title: 12. Automated decision-making
automatedDecisions.text: No automated decision-making, including profiling within the meaning of Article 22 GDPR, takes place.

changes.title: 13. Updates to this Privacy Policy
changes.text: This Privacy Policy will be updated if the website, the services used, or the legal requirements change. The version published on this page at the relevant time applies.
